format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

body: <sf-header-page id="h-order" heading="Заказы"><sf-button slot="actions" icon-start="add" text="Создать"></sf-button><sf-button slot="actions" appearance="outline" text="Импорт"></sf-button></sf-header-page>

<sf-header-page id="h-chat" heading="Анна Белова" description="в сети" heading-level="2"><sf-avatar slot="media" text="АБ" aria-hidden="true"></sf-avatar><sf-button-icon slot="actions" icon="group" appearance="ghost" scheme="on-surface" aria-label="Участники"></sf-button-icon></sf-header-page>

<sf-header-page id="h-alone" heading="Анна Белова"><sf-avatar slot="media" text="АБ" aria-hidden="true"></sf-avatar><sf-avatar slot="media" size="2" text="ВК" aria-hidden="true"></sf-avatar></sf-header-page>

<sf-header-page id="h-pick" heading="Не рисуется" heading-level="3"><sf-button slot="heading" appearance="ghost" scheme="on-surface" icon-end="expand_more" text="Ассистент"></sf-button></sf-header-page>

probes.title: the heading is the page's h1 and the count a badge
star off and on draw a star in that state; absent draws none

steps.check: (() => { const off = document.querySelector('#h .sf-page-header-star button'); const on = document.querySelector('#h-on .sf-page-header-star button'); return off && off.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'false' && off.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'В избранное' && on.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true' && on.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'В избранное' && !document.querySelector('#h-none .sf-page-header-star') && document.querySelector('#h').star === false && document.querySelector('#h-on').star === true && document.querySelector('#h-none').star === undefined; })()

probes.title: a pressed star in the toggle look takes --sf-page-header-star-color (set by the page around it) on its glyph, else the toggle's pressed ink

steps.check: (() => { const h = document.querySelector('#h-on'); const host = h.querySelector('.sf-page-header-star--toggle.sf-page-header-star--on'); const btn = host && host.querySelector('button[aria-pressed="true"]'); const g = btn && btn.querySelector('.sf-icon'); if (!g) return false; const before = getComputedStyle(g).color; const page = h.parentElement; page.style.setProperty('--sf-page-header-star-color', 'rgb(1, 2, 3)'); const set = getComputedStyle(g).color; page.style.removeProperty('--sf-page-header-star-color'); return set === 'rgb(1, 2, 3)' && getComputedStyle(g).color === before && before !== set; })()

probes.title: pressing the star sends sf-page-header-toggle {on}, then the dated sf-page-header-star, and the star turns on
probes.covers: events.toggle, aliases.json sf-page-header-star, keyboard Enter/Space (the native button)

probes.title: a host that cancels the request keeps the star as it was, and writes it itself
an install page says so in the element's language

steps.check: [...document.querySelectorAll('#h-none sf-badge')].some((b) => b.getAttribute('text') === 'для всех сайтов') && [...document.querySelectorAll('#h-en sf-badge')].some((b) => b.getAttribute('text') === 'for all sites') && document.querySelector('#h-en .sf-page-header-star button').getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Add to favourites'

probes.title: the public variables reach what the header draws
the header places the main (filled) action last, the outlined one before it (C161 (3))

steps.check: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('#h-order .sf-page-header-actions'); const texts = [...row.querySelectorAll(':scope > sf-button')].map((b) => b.getAttribute('text')); return texts.join(',') === 'Импорт,Создать'; })()

probes.title: the tabs slot ends the drawn header; sticky is off by default (C161 (5), (7))

steps.check: (() => { const hd = document.querySelector('#h-tabs > .sf-page-header'); return hd.lastElementChild.classList.contains('sf-page-header-tabs') && !!hd.querySelector('.sf-page-header-tabs sf-tabs') && document.querySelector('#h-tabs').sticky === false && getComputedStyle(hd).position === 'static'; })()

probes.title: heading-level changes the tag only; the description is a line under the heading; an avatar in the media slot takes the line's rung, a size the page wrote stays (C161, 1.10.0)

steps.check: (() => { const h = document.querySelector('#h-chat'); const h2 = h.querySelector('.sf-page-header-name > h2.sf-page-header-heading'); const line = h.querySelector('.sf-page-header-name > .sf-page-header-description'); const media = h.querySelector('.sf-page-header-title > .sf-page-header-media > sf-avatar'); const one = document.querySelector('#h h1'); const alone = [...document.querySelectorAll('#h-alone .sf-page-header-media > sf-avatar')]; return !!h2 && h2.textContent.trim() === 'Анна Белова' && !h.querySelector('h1') && getComputedStyle(h2).fontSize === getComputedStyle(one).fontSize && line && line.textContent.trim() === 'в сети' && media && media.getAttribute('size') === '1' && h.querySelector('.sf-page-header-title').firstElementChild === h.querySelector('.sf-page-header-media') && alone.length === 2 && alone[0].getAttribute('size') === '1/2' && alone[1].getAttribute('size') === '2' && !document.querySelector('#h .sf-page-header-description') && !document.querySelector('#h .sf-page-header-media'); })()

probes.title: a control in the heading slot stands inside the heading element at heading-level, in place of the heading's words

steps.check: (() => { const h3 = document.querySelector('#h-pick h3.sf-page-header-heading'); return !!h3 && !!h3.querySelector('sf-button') && !h3.textContent.includes('Не рисуется') && !document.querySelector('#h-pick h1'); })()
